# Amber Property Corner - Real Estate Advisory & Turnkey Construction

> Amber Property Corner is a verified real estate agency and architectural construction consultancy based in Karachi, Pakistan. Led by Senior Advisor Syed Sikander Waqar, the agency specializes in verified residential houses, commercial plots, SBCA/KDA legal documentation checks, and turnkey house construction.

## Core Karachi Focus Areas
- North Nazimabad: Blocks A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N (120 Gaz, 240 Gaz, 400 Gaz, 500 Gaz bungalows & corner plots).
- Gulshan-e-Iqbal: Blocks 1 to 19, Block 13-C, Block 6, Block 10A (Residential houses, commercial plazas, and prime plots).
- Federal B Area (F.B Area): Blocks 1 to 21 (Family bungalows, portions, and commercial plots).
- Scheme 33 (Gulzar-e-Hijri): Cooperative housing societies, newly constructed luxury bungalows, and gated communities.
- Buffer Zone & North Karachi: Sectors 15-A, 15-B, 11-A, 11-B (Economical to luxury residential properties).
- Scheme 45 (Taiser Town): MDA-approved residential and commercial investment plots.

## Services Offered
1. Verified Property Buying & Selling: Full title check, Registry, Sanad, Lease, sub-lease, mutation, and property tax due diligence.
2. Legal SBCA / KDA Approvals: Building layout plan approvals, Demolition NOCs, regularization, and ownership transfer assistance.
3. Turnkey House Construction: End-to-end architectural design, Grade-60 steel reinforcement, grey structure, and luxury Italian-tile finishing.
4. Property Valuation & Investment Advisory: Instant market rate assessment per square yard (Gaz) across Karachi.

## Key Properties & Dimensions Available
- 120 Sq Yards (Gaz): 3 to 4 Bed single & double storey houses.
- 240 Sq Yards (Gaz): 4 to 6 Bed executive family residences.
- 500+ Sq Yards (Gaz): Luxury corner bungalows and prime commercial plots.
